articles.title: 'Want To Hide In Food Truck Again?': Iran Roasts Trump For Switching Planes After Hormuz Declaration
articles.description: Iran has fired back after U.S. President Donald Trump declared that the strategic Strait of Hormuz would become "America's territory." Senior Iranian lawmaker Ebrahim Azizi mocked Trump, warning that the U.S. president should worry about his own security instead of making threats over Hormuz. Azizi's remarks referenced reports that Trump secretly switched aircraft and allegedly used a catering truck as part of a high-security operation while leaving the NATO summit in Turkey amid an alleged Iranian assassination threat.

articles.title: Bigg Boss 7 fame Sofia Hayat backs responsible ownership after Patiala Pitbull attack, opposes breed ban
articles.description: Actress Sofia Hayat calls for responsible pet ownership following a recent Pitbull attack in Patiala. She argues that it's unjust to stereotype entire breeds due to individual incidents. Responsible training and aware ownership are essential for ensuring public safety. Educating communities about canine behavior can help mitigate future attacks. The discussion on stricter regulations and breed-specific bans continues to gain traction throughout India.
